scope: Diretrizes de recursos dos agentes neste host; sem alteração do runtime do produto

checks.preserved_content_outside_block: passed: existing contents compared with byte snapshots
checks.idempotent_transformation: passed: prepared result unchanged by second transformation
checks.prime_native_loader: passed: global file and both project/ancestor files discovered by installed loadProjectContextFiles export
checks.frontmatter: passed: installed yaml parser, Cursor and Continue alwaysApply=true, VS Code Local applyTo=**
checks.extension_inventory: passed: Continue found in VS Code/Cursor; Copilot found bundled with VS Code

private_recovery.contents: original instruction bytes, modes, before/after hashes, target inventory, policy block
private_recovery.remote_recovery: versioned policy and sanitized client mapping; private previous configurations require separate recovery before reinstall

host_readonly_sample.interpretation: sample only; no stress or stability certification

limits: No IDE/session restart or model request performed for verification
Rules are context guidance, not kernel-enforced resource caps or proof of model compliance
Existing sessions may require a supported context reload or a new session
Future profiles, newly installed agents, containers and remote environments require their own propagation
Old PhaseZero launcher wrappers with missing target were not repaired
No claim that these changes fix the physical cause of abrupt resets
